final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet
M9  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* tail current source
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=24 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinp side drives first-stage output n1)
M1  n1 vinp tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.3
M2  n2 vinn tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.3
* PMOS mirror load (diode on vinn side)
M3  n2 n2 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5
M4  n1 n2 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M7  vout n1 vdd vdd pfet W=80 L=0.5
M8  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=96 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n1 nc 600
Cc  nc vout 6e-13
.ends dut
